Applies request-scoped external findings before output rendering

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract_with_external_redaction, ExtractInput, ExtractInputKind
from xberg._xberg import ExtractionConfig

async def main() -> None:
    input = ExtractInput(bytes=[116, 111, 107, 101, 110, 45, 55, 52, 50, 57, 32, 101, 109, 97, 105, 108, 101, 100, 32, 97, 108, 105, 99, 101, 64, 101, 120, 97, 109, 112, 108, 101, 46, 99, 111, 109, 46], filename="external-findings.txt", kind=ExtractInputKind("bytes"), mime_type="text/plain")
    config = ExtractionConfig.from_json("{}")
    findings = [{"label": "inspection_token", "score": 0.99, "text": "token-7429"}]
    offset_encoding = "unicode_code_points"
    max_findings = 8
    result = await extract_with_external_redaction(input, config, findings, offset_encoding, max_findings)
    print(result.results[0].content)

asyncio.run(main())
```
